The format of the code is specified as follows:
Line 1: Number of variable nodes
Line 2: Number of check nodes
Line 3: Number of edges
Line 4: Field (2 because binary)
Line 5: Maximum variable node degree
Line 6: Maximum check node degree
Lines 7-end: <vnode index> <cnode index> where vnode and cnode indices start from 0
